The position of '''Prime Oligarch''' was held by the leader of the [[Cadinth Oligarchy]], which led the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Cadinth]] during the waning [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Rankwin Fopow]] held the title<ref name="Article" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|55|jediwatch/1359_2.html|Cadinth Loyalty Uncertain After Jedi Death}} is set on the date 13:5:9, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] according to the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

He declared his government's support of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] against the Separatists. After a pro-Separatist [[Saskapeg uprising|uprising]] on Cadinth resulted in the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the planet's [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]], [[Bodis-Ker Vitan]], the government retracted the planet's endorsement of the Republic, with Fopow later declaring that the planet was instead "firmly undecided" between the two groups. Fopow's statement was included in an issue of the [[HoloNet News CoCo District Edition|CoCo District Edition]] of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]].<ref name="Article" />

==Behind the scenes==
The title of Prime Oligarch was mentioned in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 55|''HoloNet News Vol. 531 #55'']], a<ref name="Article" /> [[May 9]], [[2002]]<ref name="HNN55 date">{{JCFCite|url=posts/6774521|board=Literature|thread=The Official HoloNetNews Discussion Thread|user=IAmTheDarkSide|date=2002-05-09|time=4:55 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200305125429/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-official-holonetnews-discussion-thread.5990764/page-13}}</ref> issue of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]]. The article that references him, entitled "Cadinth Loyalty Uncertain After Jedi Death,"<ref name="Article" /> was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and [[Paul Ens]].<ref name="HNN Credits">{{HoloNetNewsWeb||credits.html|Credits}}</ref>
